top_signals.title: Yen Jumps on US Data as Traders Watch for Intervention Clues
top_signals.summary: The yen surged against a weaker dollar after an unexpectedly soft US payrolls report on Friday, with traders on alert for any sign authorities were preparing to intervene in the Japanese currency again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
